note: Developer retrieval APIs are experimental AI-search visibility proxies; they almost never measure consumer ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity/Copilot UI behavior.

retrieval_capable_providers.name: OpenAI Responses API web_search
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Hosted tools:[{type:web_search}] on POST /v1/responses. Returns web_search_call (queries/actions), url_citation annotations, optional sources via include. Prefer web_search over web_search_preview. Also gpt-5-search-api on Chat Completions with web_search_options (always searches).

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Perplexity Sonar / Agent API
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Sonar/Sonar Pro real-time web search with citations[] and search_results[]. Endpoint https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/sonar. Migrating to Agent API with web_search tool; Sonar supported until 2026-09-27. disable_search available for LLM-only.

suggested_fields.search_queries: often absent on Sonar; Agent API may expose via tool/output

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Google Gemini Grounding with Google Search
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Enable google_search tool (Interactions or generateContent). Returns webSearchQueries / google_search_call.queries, groundingChunks or url_citation annotations, Search Suggestions HTML (display required when present). Gemini 3 billed per search query; 2.5- older per prompt.

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Anthropic Claude web_search tool
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Server tools web_search_20250305 / _20260209 / _20260318 on Messages API. Returns server_tool_use.input.query, web_search_result urls, text citations (web_search_result_location). ~$10/1k searches + tokens. Not on Bedrock.

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Microsoft Grounding with Bing Search (Foundry)
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Classic Bing Search APIs retired 2025-08-11. Use bing_grounding tool via Azure AI Foundry Agents + Bing resource/project connection. Returns grounded answer with url_citation; must display Bing query URL. ~$14/1k transactions. Not consumer Copilot.

suggested_fields.search_queries: tool Bing query / bing.com/search?q= when exposed

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Tavily Search API
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Search backend for LLM agents, not a consumer AI UI. POST /search returns ranked results with url/content; optional LLM answer. Credit-based depth tiers.

retrieval_capable_providers.name: Exa Search API
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Neural/web search API with highlights/text/summary and optional outputSchema grounding. Not a consumer AI UI.

retrieval_capable_providers.name: SerpAPI
retrieval_capable_providers.api_notes: Google (and other) SERP JSON scrape. Traditional search baseline for AEO; not ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity UI measurement.

llm_only_providers.name: OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses without web_search or search models
llm_only_providers.api_notes: Standard chat models with no tools do not retrieve the live web. Confirmed contrast in OpenAI docs: use Responses web_search or gpt-5-search-api for search; otherwise parametric knowledge only.

llm_only_providers.name: Gemini generateContent / Interactions without google_search tool
llm_only_providers.api_notes: No groundingMetadata / search steps without google_search enabled.

llm_only_providers.name: Anthropic Messages API without web_search / web_fetch tools
llm_only_providers.api_notes: No server-side web retrieval unless web_search_* or web_fetch_* tools are declared.

llm_only_providers.name: Perplexity Sonar with disable_search
llm_only_providers.api_notes: OpenAPI documents disable_search to respond from training data only.
